name: Blast Radius — stats, tree groups, graph legend and Prior PRs
description: Walks the Overview tab's Blast Radius panel (L04) on the seeded index fixture (server/src/db/seed-blast.ts): the four stat counts, the tree view's first-open rateLimit() group with its caller and endpoint chip, expanding the collapsed-by-default listUsers() group to see its caller and cron chip, the graph view's legend (never asserts SVG node text — node labels are shortened to fit and carry only a <title>), switching back to tree, and the collapsed-by-default Prior PRs block with its one seeded cached history row (no GitHub call). Degraded badge, Resync button and an empty Prior PRs list never render against this fixture (the seeded index is 'full') and are covered where their absence can actually be asserted: BlastRadiusPanel.test.tsx and PriorPrs.test.tsx. Never clicks Run Review or Re-run — both call the LLM. Read-only seeded data, no model call. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — guaranteed by e2e-web.yml.
